Load data
```{r}

## P. pacificus data
ddc_slope_A_ppa <-read.csv("ddc_slope_A_ppa.csv")
ddc_slope_A_ppa <- ddc_slope_A_ppa[-c(26:34),] # remove the right end of values
ddc_slope_A_ppa <- cbind(ddc_slope_A_ppa, rep("A", nrow(ddc_slope_A_ppa))) # add column for chromosome and fill in A for all rows
ddc_slope_A_ppa <- ddc_slope_A_ppa[,c(4,8,9)] # subset slope, s_bp, and chromosome columns
colnames(ddc_slope_A_ppa) <- c("slope", "s", "chromosome") # rename columns 

ddc_slope_X_ppa <-read.csv("ddc_slope_X_ppa.csv")
ddc_slope_X_ppa <- ddc_slope_X_ppa[-c(26:31),]
ddc_slope_X_ppa <- cbind(ddc_slope_X_ppa, rep("X", nrow(ddc_slope_X_ppa)))
ddc_slope_X_ppa <- ddc_slope_X_ppa[,c(4,8,9)]
colnames(ddc_slope_X_ppa) <- c("slope", "s", "chromosome")

# Working file
ddc_slopes_AX_ppa <- rbind(ddc_slope_A_ppa, ddc_slope_X_ppa) # combine A and X dataframes


```

Calculate the observed difference
```{r}

library(dplyr)

#this is your base code

max_slopes <- data.frame(tapply(ddc_slopes_AX_ppa$slope, ddc_slopes_AX_ppa$chrom, max)) # extract the max slope value for A and X
colnames(max_slopes) <- c("slope")

max_slopes <- merge(max_slopes, ddc_slopes_AX_ppa, by ="slope") # extract the s_bp that corresponds to the max slope for A and X
max_slopes <- max_slopes[order(max_slopes$chromosome),]
#max_slopes_A <- max_slopes[1:5,]
#mean_s_A <- mean(max_slopes_A$s)
#s_X <- max_slopes[6,2]

s_A <- max_slopes[1,2] # the s_bp for A at the max slope
s_X <- max_slopes[2,2] # the s_bp for X at the max slope
original <- s_A - s_X # the observed difference between s_A and s_X

```

```{r}

chrom = ddc_slopes_AX_ppa$chromosome
slope = ddc_slopes_AX_ppa$slope

```

Function to permute and calculate test statistic
```{r}

permutation.test <- function(chrom, slope, n){
  distribution=c()
  for(i in 1:n){
    distribution[i] <- as.data.frame(tapply(ddc_slopes_AX_ppa$slope, sample(ddc_slopes_AX_ppa$chrom, nrow(ddc_slopes_AX_ppa), FALSE), max))
  }
  return(distribution)
}

```

Run permutation.test function and plot
```{r}

n=10000 # number of permutations
perm <- permutation.test(chrom, slope, n)

perm_df <- data.frame(t(data.frame(perm)))
colnames(perm_df) <- c("A", "X")
rownames(perm_df) <- 1:n


perm_df_A <- data.frame(perm_df[,1])
colnames(perm_df_A) <- c("slope")

perm_df_X <- data.frame(perm_df[,2])
colnames(perm_df_X) <- c("slope")

bp_A <- merge(perm_df_A, ddc_slopes_AX_ppa, by = "slope")
bp_X <- merge(perm_df_X, ddc_slopes_AX_ppa, by = "slope")

bp_all = data.frame(cbind(bp_A[,2], bp_X[,2]))
colnames(bp_all) <- c("s_A", "s_X")

bp_all$s_diff <- bp_all$s_A - bp_all$s_X
bp_all <- cbind(bp_all, bp_all$s_diff/1000)
colnames(bp_all) <- c("s_A", "s_X", "s_diff", "s_diff_kb")


p_value_ppa <- mean(abs(bp_all$s_diff) >= abs(original))
                 
hist.data <- hist(bp_all$s_diff, breaks=50, col='grey', main="Permutation Distribution, P. pacificus", las=1, xlab='permuted differences in loop size between A and X')
abline(v=original, lwd=3, col="red")

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(bp_all, aes(x=s_diff)) + geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill="black", aes(y=after_stat(ncount))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = original, color = 'red', size = 0.5) +
  theme_bw() +
  xlab("Difference in loop size between A and X (bp)") +
  ylab("Frequency") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::number_format()) +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(t = 0, r = 15, b = 0, l = 0))) +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 15, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0)))

ggsave("ppa_perm.png", device="png", dpi=300)
ggsave("ppa_perm.pdf", device="pdf", dpi=300)

```
